QuestInfo.name: [Legends] Legendary Ore
QuestInfo.0: Complete tasks for Cassandra, one of the Legends Awards judges, to receive a trophy!
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra gave you a Legendary Ore. Stay logged in for 30 minutes to turn it to gold. Really?
QuestInfo.2: You were logged on for 30 minutes, and your ore turned into gold! Wow, she was serious! Take it to Cassandra.

0.0: Ah, here to beg the great Cassandra for a Maple Award, are you? Well, since you asked so nicely, I might be willing to help you out...IF you can prove that you're a real hero!

yes.0:
Here is the Legendary Ore. It is told that only a true hero of MapleStory can change this ore to gold. To make a trophy, I need that special gold, but I can't change this ore because I'm not a hero. 

If you are indeed a true hero, hold on to this ore for 30 minutes and bring it back to me once it's changed to gold. If you log out in the middle, the ore will disappear so be careful. I will give you a chance to receive a trophy with that gold.

no.0: Are you not a true hero of MapleStory?

item.0: I don't think you changed it to gold just yet...
